description: This file declares an interface for a factory class that creates instances of ISessionServerApp, used within the Rialto server manager component. It defines two create methods for constructing session server app objects, and includes necessary headers and namespace declarations.

classes.name: ISessionServerAppFactory
classes.description: An abstract factory interface for creating ISessionServerApp instances, with two overloaded create methods.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ISessionServerApp instance with specified application name, initial state, configuration, and session server app manager.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ISessionServerApp instance with only the session server app manager.
